rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a dish cooked by stewing.

example.english: This stew was cooked all night and melts in your mouth.
example.traditional: 呢味燉菜煮咗成晚，入口即化。
example.jyutping: ne1 mei6 dan6 coi3 zyu2 zo2 seng4 maan5 jap6 hau2 zik1 faa3

rows.note: Use this when stew means worry or a troubled state, rather than a food dish.

example.english: It’s really not worth getting yourself in a stew over these little things.
example.traditional: 為咗呢啲小事搞到自己咁煩惱，真係唔值得。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 gam3 faan4 nou5 zan1 hai6 m4 zik6 dak1
